WEIGHTS AND MEASURES ACT 1972

WEIGHTS AND MEASURES (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 29 of the
Weights and Measures Act 1972 [Act 71], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1.  (1)  These regulations may be cited as the Weights and Measures
(Amendment) Regulations 2016.

 (2)  These Regulations come into operation on 1 October 2016.

Amendment of Schedule 9
2. The Weights and Measures Regulations 1981 [ P.U. (A) 292/1981 ]
are amended by substituting for Schedule 9 the following Schedule:
